elaine_cs: Quick flag - Epsilon Health (eps123) onboarding: p95 latency slipping + token spend up ~15% MoM. Renewal check in ~7w. Looking for a conservative perf play we can run this week.

rahul_eng: Short list: 1) session dedupe / prompt-level TTL to avoid repeated system prompts; 2) micro-canary to int4 on non-sensitive routes; 3) routing cushions for mid-day burst.

zoe_se: Recommend a micro-canary config:```
canary_id: eps-micro-int4
percent: 6
model: rwd-neo-8b-int4
fallback: rwd-neo-8b-fp16
checklist: [p95_latency, top8_intent_acceptance, token_delta]
duration: 48h
```

kevin_ops: Routing rule (per-customer override): if session_tokens <= 550 -> rwd-compact-3b-fast; elif session_tokens <= 1200 -> eps-micro-int4; else -> rwd-neo-8b-fp16. I'll add a burst cushion for 11:30-13:30 local.

lana_product: For renewal one-pager need: baseline cost, expected delta, p95 before/after, short QA note, and a customer-facing blurb.

rahul_eng: Also propose session dedupe TTL 22s and a 60s prewarm job 5min before peak to warm KV. Should cut repeat tokens on reconnects.

deploy-bot: infra-bot: Created ticket RWD-6102 for eps123 micro-canary + route override. CI started.

elaine_cs: Action items: @rahul run 48h canary + upload eval (+3d), @kevin add console route override & PR (+2d), @zoe set TTL + prewarm script (+1d), @lana draft renewal deck (+5d). Will share customer note after 48h validation. :white_check_mark:
